title: hoshidicts aii test dictionary
author: hoshidicts
description: A tiny Assyrian Neo-Aramaic dictionary for languages/aii/tests/lookup.tsv, written for the pack. Its rows carry the pack's part-of-speech tags; the rows tagged "v n adj prep" carry every condition, as an untagged wty-aii-en row does under lookup.untaggedTerms "pass". ܒܵܬܹ̈ܐ is a form-of row, as wiktionary-to-yomitan writes them.
